name: Tubal
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs

points: The sons of Japheth settled what became Europe. Ashkenaz is a Hebrew name for Germany; Tarshish is Spain; Kittim is Rome; Javan is Greece; you can see Meshech, Tubal, and Magog on the old maps.

note.label: Genesis 10: Shem, Ham, Japheth, and Nimrod

points: The sons of Japheth are named: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 1: The Generations from Adam to Edom
